name: C++ Branch Predictor Latency/Energy Modeling Library

mentions.name: C++ Branch Predictor Latency/Energy Modeling Library
mentions.description: A C++ library that uses operator overloading to track the latency and energy consumed by math operations while a branch predictor generates predictions. Beyond computation, it also models hardware components such as registers and RAMs.
mentions.source_excerpt: We wrote a new C++ library which uses operator overloading to track the latency/energy used by math operations as the predictor predicts. In addition to computation, this library models registers, RAMs, etc.
